additional_concerns: Footnote 7 confines the holistic designation assessment to exposure below 50% of NAV. The formula consumes an operative designation rather than deciding whether designation is warranted; adding a current below-threshold prerequisite could improperly block an established designation when exposure is unknown.
Exposure measurement, LAF identification and designation verification are delegated judgments. The formula does not establish their factual or methodological correctness.

FALSE requires affirmative absence of both routes at the assessment time. It cannot mean merely that neither route has been proved, and cannot establish non-complex status, historical declassification or permission to sell.

Global conflict blocking is an additional evidentiary execution policy, not a circular requirement. It may block a result despite an independently established sufficient route; this is not a contrary legal classification.
The supplied missing dependency IDs lack identifying metadata. None can reliably be assigned to a named external authority.

The BDC definition's upstream relevance and the open-ended exposure qualification's implementation coverage remain distinct questions. Delegating input assessment does not prove that those source qualifications are implemented, but their absence from the Boolean formula does not itself establish a defective classification rule.
